protocol: CP (cp_module.cp_surrogate / fuse_per_channel, BT.601 luma, eps=1e-3) on every baseline. CP-src: per-channel alpha* fitted on the 15 SDSD train clips of seer_eval_unified.iter_sdsd_train_fitset (8 indoor with the method's SDSD-indoor ckpt, 7 outdoor with its SDSD-outdoor ckpt), clipped to [0,1]. CP-tgt: 2-fold cross-fit on the target split by scene (scenes = sorted scene_key(name), fold = index parity; each clip fused with the alpha of the other fold), clipped to [0,1]. Splits/crops/metrics as the unified ICLR eval (score_frames: uint8-RGB PSNR, LPIPS, DISTS, CLIPIQA; per clip -> mean over clips). Per-split ckpts as run_temporal_all / run_*_v2.py / run_stcd_lol.
